# Coding Standards

## General

Write code for humans first.

Prioritize readability over brevity.

## Functions

Keep functions small.

Each function should perform one task.

Avoid deeply nested logic.

Return early when possible.

## Classes

Each class should have one responsibility.

Avoid large "God" classes.

## Naming

Use descriptive names.

Avoid abbreviations.

Names should explain intent.

## Duplication

Do not duplicate logic.

Extract reusable components.

## Comments

Write comments only when the intent cannot be expressed through code.

Avoid redundant comments.

## Formatting

Keep formatting consistent.

Group related code together.

Separate unrelated logic.

## Documentation

Public APIs should include documentation.

Document behavior rather than implementation.
